decide whether the pipeline should continue past this stage

Decide which constituent club of the shared registration 'Kongsberg/Tønsberg' (JU12) should carry this hosting obligation. Calendar availability must not by itself decide the winner -- weigh current hosting burden/fairness first; a chosen constituent with no trustworthy calendar still keeps the obligation and becomes a manual placement instead of switching to the other constituent.

chosen_club.description: The constituent club that will carry this hosting obligation. Must be one of the registration's own constituents.

action.rationale: Kongsberg has hosted far fewer total (5 vs 14) for this shared registration and has a trustworthy calendar for automatic placement; fairness favors Kongsberg over calendar convenience.

result.rationale: Kongsberg has hosted far fewer total (5 vs 14) for this shared registration and has a trustworthy calendar for automatic placement; fairness favors Kongsberg over calendar convenience.

context.objective: Decide whether this Stage 3 plan is good enough to finalize (keep_baseline), or another optimization attempt is worth the search budget (optimize_plan).

iterations.description: Simulated-annealing swap-attempt budget for the Stage 3 v2 local-search optimizer.

seed.description: Deterministic RNG seed for reproducible output.

move_dates.description: Also let the search swap two same-age-group tournaments' dates, not just teams.

move_dates_within_half.description: Also let the search move a single tournament to a genuinely new free date (not just swap with another scheduled date), restricted to the same side of the Christmas split as its current date (issue #293). Moving a tournament across the Christmas boundary is never a side effect of this move.

move_hosts.description: Also let the search reassign a tournament's host club to another club already fielding a team in that tournament (issue #262 P1).

move_slots.description: Also let the search reassign a tournament's start time among a fixed set of candidate windows (issue #262 P1).

date_swap_probability.description: Probability of attempting a date swap vs a team swap each step, when move_dates is true.

weights.description: Global overrides for the optimizer's penalty weights (see stage3_optimizer.DEFAULT_WEIGHTS).

engine.description: Search engine to run this optimize_plan attempt with (issue #276): 'local_search' (default) is the existing simulated-annealing optimizer; 'cp_sat' is the shadow/experimental fixed-skeleton CP-SAT participant optimizer. A cp_sat failure (missing OR-Tools, infeasible/timeout) never replaces the current best plan -- it is recorded as evidence and this attempt falls back to comparing the unchanged baseline.

solve_budget_seconds.description: CP-SAT solver wall-clock budget in seconds; ignored when engine is 'local_search'.

action.rationale: Baseline is FEASIBLE with a healthy half-split volume; this run validates the #301 participation-target fix, not seeking further optimization tradeoffs.

result.rationale: Baseline is FEASIBLE with a healthy half-split volume; this run validates the #301 participation-target fix, not seeking further optimization tradeoffs.
